subject: Design submission: a webpage with one changing author
text:
Hi Creative Bloq team,

What would you put on a webpage if the next person could replace it? That is the design prompt behind Take The Wall, a project I make. One message or project occupies the shared wall until the next takeover activates.

For your web-design coverage, the part readers can try immediately is the free canvas designer: arrange a message and compare its desktop and mobile versions. It turns a temporary public page into a small composition exercise. Publishing is a separate step, with paid checkout or reviewed free email entry.

Try the designer: https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1
Example preview: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sariserhan/company-operator/main/marketing/takethewall/assets/current-wall-preview.png

The image is an illustrative preview, not evidence of a purchase. Would this fit a short design-project feature? You can explore the designer without buying a takeover.
